alerts_released.description: Alerts the decision kept out of analysis that went back to the backlog.

alerts_reopened.description: Alerts the decision closed that were reopened.

failures.description: Steps of the revoke that failed. Run it again to finish.

status.description: `not_found` when no such decision exists in this space. Alerts that carry its tag are still put back. `denied` when the caller cannot read or write the decisions index: nothing was changed.
